scenario: A public SSH rule was added to the production payments API. AWS configuration, change, traffic, reachability, service-access, and managed-security evidence describe the resulting activity.

files.name: 01-config-snapshot.json
files.notes: Current security groups and resource relationships used to correlate the other files.

files.name: 02-config-history.json
files.notes: Contains the same current item as the snapshot plus the preceding state; one cross-file duplicate is intentional.

files.name: 03-cloudtrail.json.gz
files.notes: One successful ingress change, an exact duplicate, one failed request, and one unrelated management event.

files.name: 04-vpc-flow.log
files.notes: Default-format accepted SSH traffic and a rejected RDP probe on the Config-related ENI.

files.name: 05-reachability-analyzer.json
files.notes: A successful configuration-based path from the internet to SSH through the application security group.

files.name: 06-network-access-analyzer.json
files.notes: A Network Access Scope finding for the same public administrative path.

files.name: 07-elb-access.log
files.notes: A standard ALB HTTPS request correlated to the edge security group through Config.

files.name: 08-waf.jsonl
files.notes: One blocked SQL injection pattern and one allowed health check associated with the ALB Web ACL.

files.name: 09-cloudfront.tsv
files.notes: Legacy standard CloudFront TSV records whose origin hostname maps to the inventory ALB attachment.

files.name: 10-api-gateway.jsonl
files.notes: Structured API Gateway access logs for a successful request and a throttled request through a Config-related private API.

files.name: 11-route53-resolver.jsonl
files.notes: One normal internal lookup and one DNS Firewall-blocked domain from the attached application instance.

files.name: 12-network-firewall.jsonl
files.notes: A blocked alert and an allowed TLS flow. These remain unmatched unless firewall-to-workload context is supplied.

files.name: 13-guardduty.json
files.notes: A GuardDuty instance finding with a nested network interface and security-group association.

files.name: 14-security-hub.json
files.notes: An active ASFF control finding directly identifying the application security group.
